 4 die of dengue, 1,851 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 352 this year 
 Published : 19 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 19 October 2026, 17:40
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least four dengue patients died while 1,851 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today.
 Of the deaths, two were reported in Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) and one each in Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) and Mymensingh division, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the new deaths and cases, the total number of deaths this year rose to 352 and cases 114,251.
 Currently, 6,033 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at different hospitals across the country.
